name: GameArena
description: GameArena is a dynamic benchmark that evaluates large language model reasoning capabilities through interactive gameplay with humans. It consists of three games designed to test specific reasoning skills such as deductive and inductive reasoning, enabling fine-grained assessment and collection of step-by-step reasoning data.
reputation: A recent research benchmark from 2024 that is still emerging and has limited but growing visibility in the LLM reasoning community.
notes: Collects over 2000 game sessions and provides detailed assessments of reasoning capabilities; improves user engagement compared to prior benchmarks.
